title: Research: sharp clean selector encoding width and volume screen
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

For q=2^s same-direction C_n lanes, characterize exactly when one i^u C_d child admits an injective clean invariant encoding. The sharp least literal width has a closed formula. Put N=n+s. With any fourth-root global phase, it is always N+1. With the exact phase it is N+1 for every n>=3; at n=1 exactly selector residues s mod8 in {0,6,7} pass; at n=2 exactly {0,1,5,6,7} pass. The remaining exact-phase cases need N+2. A uniform Pascal-averaging/character proof resolves all positive widths, separately from the finite checks. Sixteen width-one lanes need d=7 with the exact phase, or d=6 with an allowed -1 phase. An explicit dyadic Walsh encoding and left inverse preserve every arbitrary complex payload with a zero complement. Dirty complement generally rotates and is not restored.

The minimum width and the following budget screen are for the literal C_d host, with no independently variable spectator factor. Common spectator fibers extend only as E tensor I with the same factor on both sides. Arbitrary spectator reassignment is outside the theorem: PROOF.md shows an unchanged-volume width-one example and a separate twofold-volume width-two example. This does not minimize a supplier’s physical recursive rank.

Within that contract, the inherited full-volume child-budget ratio is 2^(d-n-s)(d/n)^sigma > 2 for 0<sigma<1, even with every encoder/decoder/phase/preparation expense waived. This compares available upper-bound expressions, not optimal runtime. Scoped algebraic specialization and negative budget result; no physical supplier, 5% construction-gate success or new kappa. Only research/clean-selector-embedding/ is added; selected frontier unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Base 0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea; OS nonce 9a396c07a6d107acdb9a76567c1010d0; revision 3 complex-rank-shape-decoder / scope_key 02b31ebd160542c86299. Scope changed after one pre-implementation overlap pivot: Arham Tahir’s [PR1920](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1920), head 057b214aea45c65926b93ad8b95693c80f0f79c9, covers full-space reciprocal encoding and explicitly excludes this clean injective premise. [Claim/handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1901#discussioncomment-18925296).

[PR665](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/665), head d0e4f1eb295e5cce508dc76c6937290a9175e42b, already gives the general eigenspace-capacity/Walsh method for a different two-host split. The delta is the sharp single-host repeated-lane minimum width and phase dependence. [PR679](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/679), head dce137e540acd2b689281afe222cd32c0ec1f1ae, and Ross Richardson’s 8a3900c84213fd7603b99beaceaff48f501b4232 audit cover monomial routing/volume and motivate the changed premise. Exact source pins and credited scopes are in SOURCES/PREDECESSORS/TASK.

Entry baseline, assigned ceiling control and lever table pass. Final refresh at 13:54–13:55 UTC covered 573 open PR bodies including drafts, 873 local notes and directly read relevant Discussions. Numbered pages are non-atomic; no complete Discussion census or novelty certificate.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clean-selector-embedding
```

Registered CPython 3.12.14 replay passes, including 131 independent binomial/character counts, 4096 width cases, 12 complete Gaussian-dyadic fixtures (9440 intertwiner entries and 3360 Gram entries), seven semantic/domain controls, and five actual subprocess export/corruption/output tests. Normal and optimized no-Git exports pass; source/numeric/boolean-alias receipt corruptions reject; occupied output remains unchanged. 18 onboarding tests, exact source/Git pins and staged diff check pass. Separate bounded Codex proof/code reviews and a code-disjoint 576-case recurrence check agree.

PROOF.md is written all-size mathematics, distinct from these finite checks. Full selected cold replay, native/physical/hosting/production precision admission, all-size tape compiler, Lean, hosted-CI success and independent human review are not claimed.
